ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed SysInternals DebugView Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious renamed SysInternals DebugView execution

sequences.query: process_product = "Sysinternals\ DebugView" AND  NOT ((process_original_file_name = "Dbgview\.exe" AND process_path = RGX("\\\\Dbgview\\\.exe$")))
